chromeEdge.name: Chrome/Edge
chromeEdge.instruction: Click the Puzzle/Shield icon in your toolbar → find your AdBlocker → Toggle 'OFF' for this site.
chromeEdge.step1: Look for the Puzzle piece icon or Shield icon in your browser toolbar
chromeEdge.step2: Find your AdBlocker extension in the dropdown menu
chromeEdge.step3: Toggle the switch to 'OFF' for this site

brave.name: Brave
brave.instruction: Click the Lion icon next to the URL bar → Toggle Shields to 'Down'.
brave.step1: Locate the Brave Lion icon next to the address bar
brave.step2: Click 'Shields' and toggle it to 'Down' for this site

safari.name: Safari
safari.instruction: Go to Settings → Safari → Content Blockers → Disable for Integri AI.
safari.step3: Find 'Integri AI' and disable content blocking

ublock.name: uBlock Origin
ublock.instruction: Click the uBlock icon → Click the large Power Button → Refresh.
ublock.step1: Click the uBlock Origin icon in your toolbar
ublock.step2: Click the large Power Button to disable uBlock for this site
